newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Pareks Bank expects S&P, Thomson ratings.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Pareks Bank expects S&P, Thomson ratings.

text.p: Leading Latvian bank Pareks Bank said on Friday that it is currently being rated by rating agencies Standard & Poors and Thomson BankWatch.
"We will have two ratings and it is expected to take a couple of months before the ratings are actually assigned," a bank spokeswoman said.
Latvia was this year assigned a BBB investment-grade rating by Standard & Poors.
Pareks would be the first Latvian bank to get an S&P rating although third-largest bank Rigas komercbanka already has a Thomson long-term debt rating of BB-.
Thomson has also assigned ratings to leading Lithuanian commercial banks Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank and has said it would do more ratings of banks in Estonia.
